patch_description:
The current program (score 0.43) has regressed from the prior best (score 0.60) by:
1. Increasing parameters from 7 to 9 distinct param names
2. Splitting ZZ gates into individual parameters (zz_04, zz_26, zz_15) instead of sharing
3. Over-parameterization on a tiny training set causes poor generalization (gap 0.23)

I will restore the aggressive parameter sharing strategy that achieved 0.60:
- Consolidate all ZZ gates to a single shared parameter "zz_diag"
- Keep YY gates on a single shared parameter "yy_cross"
- Keep XX gates on a single shared parameter "xx_near"
- Maintain even/odd sharing for RY and RZ layers

This reduces distinct parameters from 9 back to 6, improving parameter efficiency and generalization. The fixed repetition architecture (N_REPEATS=3) naturally provides depth while parameters are shared, creating a regularization effect through repetition without explosion in parameter count.
